items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: He's the same as Duck. All of them out there in Barber.

ctx.x: About him. About him. About him. About him. You remember Louis Lillet? I know Louis Lillet, yeah. Much. Much, I know.
He's the same as Duck. All of them out there in Barber.
Seems like a lot of the musicians used to be barbers.
